_note: JVM parse verdicts recorded 2026-09-20 using scripts/jvm_serde_oracle/ErgoSerdeOracle.scala (sigma-state 6.0.2, Scala 2.12).

Reproduce: send each `ergo_tree <tree_hex>` line to scala-cli run scripts/jvm_serde_oracle/ErgoSerdeOracle.scala; also probed sized, sizeless-v0, and undersized rejects with cargo run -p ergo-difftest -- --oracle --repro <hex> --surface ergo_tree.
ConstantPlaceholderSerializer.scala:16-24 reads constantStore.get(id) before constructing the node. ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException escapes the soft-fork wrap.
The valid-index controls show that a declared frame size differing from the structural body size is accepted by the JVM; the undersized rejection is caused by the placeholder index.
